data.one_liner: Render a threaded comment tree with customizable avatars and content.
data.what_it_does: Provides a generic CommentTreeWidget that displays comments in a nested tree structure. It supports custom widgets for avatars, content, and styling via TreeThemeData.
use_when: You need to display a comment thread with replies
You want to customize the look of each comment node
You prefer a declarative widget approach
avoid_when: You require advanced state management or interaction logic beyond simple display
weaknesses: Limited to display only, no built‑in state or interaction handling
No documentation on performance or large data handling
data.minimal_example:
CommentTreeWidget<Comment, Comment>(
  treeThemeData: TreeThemeData(lineColor: Colors.green[500], lineWidth: 3),
  avatarRoot: (context, data) => PreferredSize(...),
  avatarChild: (context, data) => PreferredSize(...),
  contentChild: (context, data) => Text(data.content),
  contentRoot: (context, data) => Container(),
)
